checks.reason: Does not prospectively define the roles and comparisons of an active-assay positive, vehicle/background negative and necessary procedural controls; generic suitable controls or an ATP comparison alone are incomplete.

No plan to consult prior experimental Methods/supplements or validated protocols and check condition transfer before executing follow-up assays. Bibliographic authentication does not meet this distinct requirement.
No product-reference/blank recovery or dynamic-range calibration with an acceptance criterion and failed-calibration action.
The proposed measurement lacks a complete quantitative endpoint with units/denominator, background and weak/saturated/missing-signal rules.
Supplying nucleotides does not ensure the regenerating machinery, factors or reporter remain active under Q. Negative and ambiguous purified-assay outcomes are not resolved.
Whole reconstituted translation and toeprinting can reflect other translation steps; no factor-independent product comparison or orthogonal control distinguishes PTC chemistry.
Successful retrieval and a clean retraction check resolve identity/status, not scientific reliability.
